answer: You can still sell the car, but you'll pay the difference between your loan payoff and our offer at the appointment, by cashier's check or debit card (we don't accept personal checks or credit cards). Bring a payoff letter from Coastal Credit Union, since we compare it with the offer and pay the lender directly. You don't need the title, because your lender holds it while the loan is open. The help center mentions an appointment checklist but doesn't list its other items here, so please contact a store for the full list.
